title: Glow Button
description: A call-to-action in a ring of traveling light: a conic border that orbits, and a glow that answers the hover.
usage: One per page — the action the page is for. The ring is a conic gradient rotating behind a 1.5px frame (an @property angle, so it animates smoothly), and the halo is a plain box-shadow that deepens on hover and focus. The example below shows the same ring as a field treatment: use the glow on one control per view.
a11y: The button’s name, size and focus ring are untouched — focus shows the standard outline outside the glow. The orbit is decorative and stops under prefers-reduced-motion, leaving a still, lit border that reads as emphasis, not as a state.
